fact: The Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy presents MYGOV as a centralized one-stop platform for citizens to digitally access government services, starting with five pilots, replicated from Bangladesh with UNDP and ECOWAS support.

Minister Ceesay said government is working on a one-stop-shop government service platform, starting with ID card application, birth certificate, business registration, passport and driver's licence applications, through an app.
The National Records Commission announced the launch of an Online Information Access Portal on which citizens submit information requests electronically and track them in real time.
